# SeeYourTravel

> SeeYourTravel.app is a free web app for creating, sharing and replaying journeys on a map. A route is played back with photos, places (Wikipedia, Google, your own), weather and the elevation profile along the way. Signed-in users also get an AI assistant (Google Gemini) and a photo search that understands what a photo looks like.

## Main pages
- [Home: the interactive map](https://seeyourtravel.app/): pick a public journey and watch it replay.
- [Public journeys](https://seeyourtravel.app/track/): the list of public routes, each with its own text page.
- [About and corporate information](https://seeyourtravel.app/corporate/): features, the AI companion and contact details.
- [Press kit](https://seeyourtravel.app/press/): logos, screenshots and a short description.
- [Sitemap](https://seeyourtravel.app/sitemap.xml)

## Facts
- Languages: English, Ukrainian, German, Hebrew. Works on phones and desktops.
- Private tracks and photos are never shown to visitors; only content its owner made public is on the public pages.
- Source code: https://github.com/oltur/seeyourtravel
- Contact: info@seeyourtravel.app
